name: @platformatic/memcached
description: Minimal, high-performance memcached client for Node.js based on the meta text protocol

scripts.pretest: npm run build && (docker run -d --rm --name plt-memcached-test -p 11211:11211 memcached:alpine > /dev/null 2>&1 || true) && (docker run -d --rm --name plt-memcached-auth-test -p 11214:11211 -v "$(pwd)/test/fixtures:/auth:ro" memcached:alpine memcached -Y /auth/authfile > /dev/null 2>&1 || true)
scripts.posttest: docker rm -f plt-memcached-test plt-memcached-tls-test plt-memcached-auth-test > /dev/null 2>&1 || true

author: Platformatic Inc. <oss@platformatic.dev> (https://platformatic.dev)
